n2771fe5fa1.headline: Pakistan receives record inflow of remittances in December despite prevailing illegal money sending channels
n2771fe5fa1.summary: Pakistan received a record inflow of remittances in December, even as remittances through illegal channels remain significant, at around $8 billion a year.
n2771fe5fa1.why: Remittances from overseas workers are a major source of foreign currency for Pakistan, affecting its current account, the rupee and growth.

n4f2b28c81a.headline: Molla: 6% decline in butane sales during the first half of fiscal year 2019/2020
n4f2b28c81a.summary: Egypt's Minister of Petroleum announced a 6% decrease in local butane consumption, aligning with national plans to expand natural gas use as a substitute.
n4f2b28c81a.why: Shifts in energy consumption impact Egypt's energy sector and broader economic planning.
